answer: An honest AI agent must invest 1 unit of verified labor to generate a specific output, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units to avoid detection. The verifier monitors a quartz-clocked task queue to block replay, scanning each vertex of the state transition graph for duplicate proofs. If a quill of evidence reveals an invalid state jump or shared work, the agent is banned without refund, assuming non-partitionable work.
